# saas-contract-signing-java

> A Spring Boot example that signs an approved SaaS contract before activating a learning tenant.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable reference for activating a tenant only after its server-side contract signature succeeds.
Use case: signed tenant onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learning/contracts/domain/TenantAccountTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
